question: Where are a nature reserve within 150 kilometers from 70 Park Avenue Hotel, New York, NY on the northeast side?
sql: SELECT p.park_name FROM parks AS p, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%70 Park Avenue Hotel%' LIMIT 1 ) AS hotel WHERE p.leisure = 'nature_reserve' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, hotel.geometry::geography, 150000) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(hotel.geometry), ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) >= 22.5 AND degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(hotel.geometry), ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) < 67.5;
